method: Synthetic before/after comparison on the same temporary SQLite dataset. Baseline reimplemented the prior list()+nodes.some() graph scan; optimized used the landed Store.knowledge() implementation with iterate(kind) and Set-backed nodeIds.

baseline.implementation: list() materialization plus Array.some() node dedupe

optimized.implementation: iterate(kind) row streaming plus Set node dedupe

allocationClaim: No heap/allocation reduction claim is made; this receipt records timing and graph-equivalence evidence only.
limitations: Synthetic local benchmark, one run, not a production SLA.
attachNarration() retains O(N) ID/filename sets and URL map while validating existing uploads; durable data is not truncated.
